title: Touhou Hisoutensoku ~ Choudokyuu Ginyoru no Nazo o Oe - Shanghai Shoryuken ~ Shanghai Teahouse ~ Chinese Tea (SMW-Mix)
description:
𝐘𝐨𝐮'𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐞𝐭! 𝐘𝐨𝐮'𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝟒𝟎𝟎𝟎 𝐲𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲!

A remix of Ke- *ahem* Hong Meiling's theme from Touhou 12.3: Hisoutensoku, Shanghai Teahouse ~ Chinese Tea. A fantastic variation of my favorite stage theme (belonging to one of the coolest characters in the series).

This song can fit boss fights, final boss fights, and anything else related to fighting a worthy opponent.

Note:
There are three customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the txt file:
- F Minor (Original Pitch, set by default)
- F# Minor (EoSD Pitch)
- E Minor (Custom Pitch)
